# VidRank

> VidRank is an AI-powered YouTube SEO tool that generates optimized titles, descriptions, keywords, and tags from a video title or renamed video file name. Free plan: 10 generations/day; Pro: $3.99/month unlimited. Available as a web app and a free Chrome extension.

## Products

- [VidRank Web App](https://vidrank.tech/): AI YouTube SEO generator — turn a video title or file name into a full SEO package
- [VidRank Chrome Extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/vidrank/meafpgipnldknnbnmahbmbaakcmahogk): free Chrome extension that generates optimized YouTube titles, descriptions, and tags in one click, on the Chrome Web Store

## Main pages

- [Home](https://vidrank.tech/): AI-powered YouTube SEO generator — turn a video title into a full SEO package
- [Blog](https://vidrank.tech/blog): YouTube SEO guides and optimization tips
- [Pricing](https://vidrank.tech/#pricing): Free plan (10 generations/day) and Pro at $3.99/month

## Free tools

- [YouTube Tag Extractor](https://vidrank.tech/tools/youtube-tag-extractor): free tool that shows any YouTube video's exact tags, ranked in the order its creator added them, with one-click copy

## FAQ

- What is VidRank? An AI-powered YouTube optimization engine that generates titles, descriptions, keywords, and tags automatically.
- Does VidRank have a Chrome extension? Yes. VidRank has a free Chrome extension that generates optimized YouTube titles, descriptions, and tags in one click, available on the Chrome Web Store.
- How does VidRank work? Rename your video file or enter your title; the AI extracts niche, search intent, and keywords, then generates your SEO package.
- How much does VidRank cost? Free plan includes 10 generations per day; Pro is $3.99/month with unlimited generations.
